angles.angle: Bitcoin frees people from having to accept government money.
Bitcoin builds its own economic system that no government can control.
No one controls Bitcoin's value; it is set by free individual choice and open market forces.

takeaways.text: The medley suggests that opting out of state-issued money is not just a political win; it is a starting point for a freer, more abundant digital future.
To me, the throughline is that escape from a default system matters more than any temporary political or market victory.
